questions: For decode_cyclic, should it assume the input is exactly as produced by encode_cyclic, or should it handle any string (e.g., with length not a multiple of 3) gracefully?
In encode_cyclic, when a group has fewer than 3 characters, does it remain unchanged, or is there any padding or special handling?
Is the shifting direction in encode_cyclic always leftward (group[1:] + group[0]), or could it be rightward (group[-1] + group[:-1])?
Should decode_cyclic work by applying encode_cyclic twice, as in the reference, or by directly reversing the shift (e.g., group[-1] + group[:-1] for groups of 3)?
Are the groups formed from the start of the string, or could they overlap or be sliding windows?
Does encode_cyclic treat the input string as mutable or immutable (e.g., should it handle non-string inputs or convert them)?
If the input string is empty, should encode_cyclic return an empty string, or raise an error?
Should decode_cyclic raise an error if the input length is not compatible with the encoding (e.g., length constraints from grouping)?
